description: Send the trusted-device approval for a sealed draft to the user's phone and return its approval_session_id. Tell the user to answer on their phone within ~5 minutes. Once they approve there, Lovie sends the transfer by itself and notifies them of the result; you send nothing, and you must not ask the user to come back and report the approval. If the user later asks what happened, call get_transfer_draft_outcome with the draft_id. If they reject or let the approval expire, nothing is sent.
name: request_transfer_approval
title: Request Transfer Approval
